summary: Being seen for something can bring back the exact memory that taught you to hide it.
body: Being seen for something can bring back the exact memory that taught you to hide it. When the Sun conjuncts Chiron, recognition and an older sensitivity can arrive in the same moment, so praise for your work, attention on your appearance, or being asked to take the lead may feel more exposing than the situation itself explains. The attention may be welcome and uncomfortable at once. Notice what is happening now before you make the people in front of you answer for the people who taught you that visibility came with a price.
